Two directions clear the engineering gate — Editorial on the cleanest and most honest construction, Desk on the strongest engineering artifact (planPage dedupe, first-party measurement) despite three self-account nicks — while Index is one folder-move and two stale claims from the bar, and Rail's zero-byte purity conceals a latent contract-type hole at the exact point the governing rule lives; nothing here is category-unfit.

candidates.label: A
strengths: The arrival ritual — address-you headline over the small-caps margin dateline (READ AT 08:40 ON THURSDAY 16 JULY.) — feels like a private paper prepared for one reader; do not sand off the dateline or the direct address.

The quiet day compresses the entire page to a single serene screen (headline, one honest sentence, colophon receipt) — the page itself becomes quiet; this compression is the direction's emotional core and must survive any remediation.

The colophon 'HOW THIS PAGE WAS READ' stages the accounting as a printed receipt of candour — trust delivered as typography, and the failure-day colophon line refusing a wrong total lands with real gravity there.
Colour spent as truth only — one indigo rule, red reserved for lateness and failure — keeps the red top rule on provider_failure genuinely felt rather than decorative.
candidates.weakest: editorial__briefing__owner_signature__1440x960.png — seventeen rows of identical typographic temperature; 'Moving well' is indistinguishable in feeling from 'Needs review', so the reader's emotional register flattens the further they read from the headline.
concerns: Feeling lives only at the page's extremes: the headline greets and the colophon reassures, but the long grey middle of every list page is emotionally inert.
One note played extremely well — respect and gravitas without warmth; the austerity risks reading as clinical over months of daily use.
Sections that should feel good (Moving well) carry no textural difference from sections that should prick (Needs review).

candidates.label: B
strengths: 'THE EDGE OF THIS READ — Nothing below this line is asking for you inside this read.' is the most emotionally generous device in the round: engineered permission to stop reading; it must never be sanded off.

Quiet vs failure as space vs stone: the quiet day is an open span between the NOW meridian and the edge, the failure day a black slab set into the same stream — the governing rule delivered as physical feeling, not words.
The first-run framing — 'BEFORE THE FIRST READ … Nothing failed, and nothing here counts as zero' with the only filled action button in the set — is the warmest new_user moment of the four.
The briefing's closing assurance 'This is the whole read. Nothing was held back from it.' and the 'WHERE YOU WERE' return link are trust rendered as wayfinding.
candidates.weakest: rail__today__owner_signature__390x844__fold.png — on the founder's phone the first screen is masthead, mode grid, then three ledger blocks (THIS READ, WHAT WAS READ, WORK STARTS IN) before the NOW line; the verdict of the day is below the fold, so the morning-glance feeling fails on the most-lived device.
concerns: Receipts before greeting: on both viewports the accounting stack shares or precedes the arrival moment, so the daily first feeling is 'instrument' rather than 'briefing'.
The per-mode caption drumbeat (PARTLY READ · ONE SOURCE DID NOT ANSWER repeated four times across the nav) reads mechanical, a system log rather than a voice.
At 1440 the lower page's hard left-set content against full-width rules leaves the right half hollow, which reads unfinished rather than serene.
candidates.requiredCorrection: Re-sequence the arrival so the day's verdict is the first thing felt on every viewport: on 390, move the THIS READ / WHAT WAS READ / WORK STARTS IN blocks below the NOW meridian and first signal items so the fold shows headline, meridian, verdict sentence, first item; on 1440, let the headline and meridian own the top before any accounting block; and collapse the four repeated mode-caption qualifiers into one summarising line so the drumbeat becomes a sentence.

candidates.label: C
strengths: The warm paper is the only changed canvas in the set and it changes the feeling of arrival — a kept desk rather than a terminal; the colour temperature must not be normalised away.

The verdict-word grammar with the four-state headline rule (solid 'Read.', split 'Partly read.', red 'Did not answer.', dashed 'Nothing set up yet.') gives the founder a somatic cue: the day's nature is felt before a word is read — this sign system is the direction's soul.

The spine that physically breaks where the source did not answer, paired with 'Some sources did not answer, so this list can be short. Short is not empty.' — the governing rule made into an object plus a protective sentence; neither half may be sanded off.

The legend's promise 'nothing here is carried by a shape' and controls struck through with their reason ('nothing here is marked done until the source confirms it') build trust as a felt daily texture.
candidates.weakest: desk__today__owner_quiet__1440x960.png — still strong, but the cryptic collapsed mono label 'TRUE OF EVERY READ, NOT OF TODAY (2)' is most exposed on the near-empty quiet page, one cold bureaucratic note on the direction's calmest surface.
concerns: The break-diamond does double duty: on clean days it also marks cross-read composite rows ('6 dated items fall in the same week'), while the legend's failure-day words define it as 'the line breaks here, this could not be read' — one glyph, two meanings muddies a learned somatic cue on the day both appear.
'Coming up 4 >' collapsed on Today withholds the fortnight's feel from the arrival; the founder must click to feel what is approaching.
'TRUE OF EVERY READ, NOT OF TODAY' is the lone jargon-toned furniture on an otherwise plain-spoken page.

candidates.label: D
strengths: The contents-with-conditions table — 'Every mode, and the condition its own read is in.' with leader dots — is a real reassurance: the whole estate legible from anywhere; keep it in any remediation.
Continuous entry numbering (01–17 across the whole briefing) gives the day a felt size — the reader knows how big today is, which is its own kind of calm.

The my-work trust sentence — 'Mark as done reaches the source and waits for its answer. A row leaves this ledger only when the source confirms it, at the next read.' — is candour of the highest order and must survive.
candidates.weakest: index__today__new_user__1440x960.png — a person's first-ever screen is framed under 'WHAT LIMITED THIS READ' with roughly a dozen statements of nothing/zero/not-set-up across nav, banner and rail; the feeling is being processed by an intake clerk, not welcomed to a product.
concerns: The quiet day never exhales: the full accounting apparatus keeps equal visual weight beside a hollow content column, so calm reads as a column that failed to load rather than rest.
The failure wound is restated roughly nine times on one screen (nav ×4, banner, rail paragraph, contents ×4) — honesty repeated until it becomes anxiety.
'Not connected' is promoted into the nav beside Today on the signature day, so the qualifier shouts louder than the 'Read' verdict it qualifies.
Mono-and-badge density everywhere makes every surface feel like working papers; the direction functions admirably and moves least.
candidates.requiredCorrection: Let the calm worlds breathe and the wound speak once: on owner_quiet and new_user, collapse the right-rail apparatus to a single receipt line with the rest behind a disclosure and re-frame new_user under a welcome heading ('Where to start') rather than 'WHAT LIMITED THIS READ'; demote the 'Not connected' qualifier from the Today nav badge into the account where it explains itself; and on provider_failure state the wound once in the banner and once in the contents instead of nine times.

ballots.overallNote: This seat judged whether the founder feels anything worth keeping at arrival, on the quiet day, and on the broken day. Two directions clear the gate — Desk, which turns candour into warm, physical feeling (a verdict word, a rule with four honest states, a spine that breaks where the read broke), and Editorial, whose arrival and single-screen quiet are the finest exhale in the round; Rail hides its two most generous sentences behind a receipts-first arrival, and Index functions thoroughly while moving me least.
